# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.5 Module 2, South & Southeast Asia Maritime Silk Road (1350-1700, oe_sea_, slot 62). Generated by gen_south_se_asia.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Guarded one-time feedback into Silk Road Twin Phoenix maritime score (oe_srk_sea_score).
oe_sea_feed_srk_sea_score = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_srk_fed }
            has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level } global_var:oe_sea_corridor_level >= 3 }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_srk_fed value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_sea_score }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sea_score add = 2 }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Pure O(1) update of global_var:oe_sea_corridor_level (0..3) from 3 maritime nodes.
oe_sea_update_corridor = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_level value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_sea_node_east_ready = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_node_east value = 1 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_level add = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_node_east value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_sea_node_hub_ready = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_node_hub value = 1 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_level add = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_node_hub value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_sea_node_west_ready = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_node_west value = 1 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_level add = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_node_west value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level } global_var:oe_sea_corridor_level >= 3 }
        }
        oe_sea_feed_srk_sea_score = yes
    }
}

# Country scope. Sync tiered Maritime Silk Road corridor modifier for signatory countries (O(1)).
oe_sea_sync_corridor_tier = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_sea_corridor_signatory
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sea_corridor_signatory } var:oe_sea_corridor_signatory >= 1 }
            has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level
        }
        if = {
            limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level } global_var:oe_sea_corridor_level >= 3 } }
            remove_country_modifier = oe_sea_corridor_tier_1
            remove_country_modifier = oe_sea_corridor_tier_2
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sea_corridor_tier_3 years = 15 mode = replace }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level } global_var:oe_sea_corridor_level = 2 } }
            remove_country_modifier = oe_sea_corridor_tier_1
            remove_country_modifier = oe_sea_corridor_tier_3
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sea_corridor_tier_2 years = 15 mode = replace }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level } global_var:oe_sea_corridor_level = 1 } }
            remove_country_modifier = oe_sea_corridor_tier_2
            remove_country_modifier = oe_sea_corridor_tier_3
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sea_corridor_tier_1 years = 15 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Apply Gujarat ports diplomatic goodwill (khambat / surat owners, has_owner guarded).
oe_sea_apply_gujarat_bias = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:khambat = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { this = root } } } }
        location:khambat = {
            owner = {
                add_opinion = { modifier = oe_sea_b_malabar_charter target = root }
                root = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_sea_b_malabar_charter target = prev } }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:surat = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { this = root } } } }
        location:surat = {
            owner = {
                add_opinion = { modifier = oe_sea_b_malabar_charter target = root }
                root = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_sea_b_malabar_charter target = prev } }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Apply bilateral opinion & shared charter modifier to active corridor partners (ROM/BYZ, CHI, VIJ, MLC).
oe_sea_apply_corridor_partners = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = ROM } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:ROM }
        c:ROM = {
            add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_signatory value = 1 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $yrs$ mode = replace }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = BYZ } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = {
            add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_signatory value = 1 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $yrs$ mode = replace }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = CHI } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:CHI }
        c:CHI = {
            add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_signatory value = 1 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $yrs$ mode = replace }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VIJ c:VIJ = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = VIJ } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:VIJ }
        c:VIJ = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } }
    }
}

# Country scope. Empower live MUG (if formed) or delhi holder during Timurid southward wave.
oe_sea_empower_mughal_or_delhi = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MUG c:MUG = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = MUG } }
        c:MUG = {
            add_army_tradition = 10
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sea_timurid_southward_push years = 25 mode = replace }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:delhi = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { this = root } } } }
        location:delhi = {
            owner = { add_army_tradition = 6 }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Bind resolved host cleanly.
oe_sea_bind_host = {
    save_scope_as = oe_sea_tmp_host
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_host value = scope:oe_sea_tmp_host }
}

# Any scope. Resolve live Maritime Silk Road host:
# Human participant first (root if human participant), else VIJ > DLH > MLC > MAJ > DAI > AYU > CHI > ROM > BYZ > location owners.
oe_sea_resolve_host = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_ai = no oe_sea_participant = yes }
        oe_sea_bind_host = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VIJ c:VIJ = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } }
        c:VIJ = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:DLH c:DLH = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } }
        c:DLH = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MUG c:MUG = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } }
        c:MUG = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MLC c:MLC = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } }
        c:MLC = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MAJ c:MAJ = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } }
        c:MAJ = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:DAI c:DAI = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } }
        c:DAI = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:AYU c:AYU = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } }
        c:AYU = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } }
        c:CHI = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } }
        c:ROM = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } }
        c:BYZ = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VIJ c:VIJ = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:VIJ = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:DLH c:DLH = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:DLH = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MLC c:MLC = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:MLC = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MAJ c:MAJ = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:MAJ = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:DAI c:DAI = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:DAI = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:CHI = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:ROM = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:BYZ = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:kozhikode = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
        location:kozhikode = { owner = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:malacca = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
        location:malacca = { owner = { oe_sea_bind_host = yes } }
    }
}

# Any scope. One-time initialization (post-1350).
oe_sea_init_line = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    oe_sea_update_corridor = yes
    oe_sea_resolve_host = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_sea_has_live_host = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_on value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_end value = 8 }
    }
}

# Country scope (resolved host). Expire closed windows & dispatch at most one event per calendar month.
oe_sea_dispatch_events = {

    if = { limit = { current_year > 1520 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_fired_7 } NOT = { global_var:oe_sea_fired_7 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_fired_7 } NOT = { global_var:oe_sea_fired_7 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_fired_7 value = 2 } }

    if = { limit = { current_year > 1660 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_fired_11 } NOT = { global_var:oe_sea_fired_11 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_fired_11 } NOT = { global_var:oe_sea_fired_11 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_fired_11 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1700 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_fired_12 } NOT = { global_var:oe_sea_fired_12 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_fired_12 } NOT = { global_var:oe_sea_fired_12 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_fired_12 value = 2 } }
    oe_sea_sync_corridor_tier = yes
    if = {
        limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_ev_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_sea_ev_m = global_var:oe_sea_m } } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_sea_open_1 = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_fired_1 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_ev_m value = global_var:oe_sea_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sea.1
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_sea_open_2 = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_fired_2 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_ev_m value = global_var:oe_sea_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sea.2
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_sea_open_7 = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_fired_7 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_ev_m value = global_var:oe_sea_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sea.7
        }
        else_if = {

# Public monthly entry point (scheduler slot 62 AND oe_sea_pulse.txt fallback).
# World/regional line: takes NO BYZ main-line lock; strictly idempotent per calendar month via oe_sea_ran_m.
oe_sea_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_m value = oe_sea_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_done }
            OR = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_on current_year >= 1350 }
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_ran_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_sea_ran_m = global_var:oe_sea_m } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_ran_m value = global_var:oe_sea_m }
        oe_sea_update_corridor = yes
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_init } }
            oe_sea_init_line = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                has_global_variable = oe_sea_end
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_end } global_var:oe_sea_end = 8 }
                current_year <= 1705
            }
            oe_sea_resolve_host = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_sea_has_live_host = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_end value = 0 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_on value = 1 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year > 1705 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_end value = 3 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_done value = 2 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_sea_on
            }
            else = {
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { oe_sea_has_live_host = yes } }
                    oe_sea_resolve_host = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_sea_has_live_host = yes }
                    global_var:oe_sea_host = { oe_sea_dispatch_events = yes }
                }
                else = {
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_end value = 8 }
                    remove_global_variable = oe_sea_on
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    location:palembang = { remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_malabar_spice_port remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_sonargaon_loom_hub remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_thang_long_emporium remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_malacca_strait_hub remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_java_spice_entrepot remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_ayodhya_royal_port }
    location:ayodhya = { remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_malabar_spice_port remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_sonargaon_loom_hub remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_thang_long_emporium remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_malacca_strait_hub remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_java_spice_entrepot remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_ayodhya_royal_port }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = capital }
        capital = { remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_malabar_spice_port remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_sonargaon_loom_hub remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_thang_long_emporium remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_malacca_strait_hub remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_java_spice_entrepot remove_location_modifier = oe_sea_ayodhya_royal_port }
    }
}

oe_sea_test_start = {
    oe_sea_test_clear = yes
    oe_sea_bind_host = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_m value = oe_sea_m_now }
    oe_sea_update_corridor = yes
}

oe_sea_test_month = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_sea_ran_m
    oe_sea_monthly = yes
}

oe_sea_test_corridor3 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_on } } oe_sea_test_start = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_node_east value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_node_hub value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_node_west value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_level value = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sea_corridor_signatory value = 1 }
    oe_sea_feed_srk_sea_score = yes
    oe_sea_sync_corridor_tier = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sea.12
}
